|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 2) of a '''retired''' Virtual Modern card. '''Retired:''' the PC card data lists this card as GEMP <code>200_63</code> (“•Obi-Wan In Radiant VII”) up to 14 October 2024 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/4f5ce3088f0b72912df2eac71cf959b4b0963e2c card-json commit 4f5ce30]); from 29 December 2024 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/304ab4f68b7ed22cc324c8ffbb678420825c9ce1 card-json commit 304ab4f], “Set 24”) slot <code>200_63</code> holds [[Madakor In Radiant VII]], whose image was added on 26 December 2024 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/934fb059221a75497db7d1bb505f5cbfc24098cf holotable commit 934fb05]). The file name was reused: on 30 December 2024 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b holotable commit 9d2c01e]) the PC overwrote <code>Virtual0-Light/large/obiwaninradiantvii.gif</code> with a copy of the [[Madakor In Radiant VII]] image (pixel-identical to <code>madakorinradiantvii.gif</code> of 26 December 2024, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/934fb059221a75497db7d1bb505f5cbfc24098cf holotable commit 934fb05]); that copy belongs to Madakor In Radiant VII and is not a version of this card. Bill ruled (12 November 2026, on [[Jabba's Prize (V)]] and [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol]]) that a card whose GEMP slot was reused for another card is not part of the new card's family, so this card keeps its own version history here and is not listed with [[Madakor In Radiant VII]]. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-L-obiwaninradiantvii-2022-07-31.png]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-L-obiwaninradiantvii-2022-07-31-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-L-obiwaninradiantvii-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V0-L-obiwaninradiantvii-2022-07-31-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-L-obiwaninradiantvii-2022-07-31.png]], 31 July 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Virtual Set 0)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-V0-L-obiwaninradiantvii022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/obiwaninradiantvii.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018). Status of the file today: the PC now serves the Madakor In Radiant VII image under this file name (since 30 December 2024).</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Radiant VII”. Text: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak.' Your total ability here may not be reduced.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-V0-L-obiwaninradiantviiab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/obiwaninradiantvii.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022). Status of the file today: the PC now serves the Madakor In Radiant VII image under this file name (since 30 December 2024).</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels) with a re-coloured picture; the bottom margin “•Radiant VII” → “Radiant VII” (uniqueness dot removed); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Radiant VII”. Text: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak.' Your total ability here may not be reduced.”
* '''Retired''' (29 December 2024): the PC card data lists this card as GEMP <code>200_63</code> (“•Obi-Wan In Radiant VII”) up to 14 October 2024 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/4f5ce3088f0b72912df2eac71cf959b4b0963e2c card-json commit 4f5ce30]); from 29 December 2024 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/304ab4f68b7ed22cc324c8ffbb678420825c9ce1 card-json commit 304ab4f], “Set 24”) slot <code>200_63</code> holds [[Madakor In Radiant VII]], whose image was added on 26 December 2024 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/934fb059221a75497db7d1bb505f5cbfc24098cf holotable commit 934fb05]). The file name was reused: on 30 December 2024 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b holotable commit 9d2c01e]) the PC overwrote <code>Virtual0-Light/large/obiwaninradiantvii.gif</code> with a copy of the [[Madakor In Radiant VII]] image (pixel-identical to <code>madakorinradiantvii.gif</code> of 26 December 2024, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/934fb059221a75497db7d1bb505f5cbfc24098cf holotable commit 934fb05]); that copy belongs to Madakor In Radiant VII and is not a version of this card.
